references.name: downstream
references.observed: Annelise Lange downstream photo: curved concrete arch below a repeating open pier/crest-deck spillway; dark gate or sill structure, thick solid abutments and a pair of low round outlets at right. The river continues past both banks.

references.name: crest-and-powerhouse
references.observed: Annelise Lange oblique photo: preserve the curved wall, elevated crest deck openings and separate solid gravity wings. On the powerhouse bank, two long sloping covered runs descend beside a raised bank platform and planted median; a row of lower outlet portals and large glazed facade are visible. Keep native hills, downstream river, islands and independent access bridge.

method: Ordinary visual reference only; no image or logo is redistributed in the model.
